payload.title: File:Sauropia macrorhinus (holotype, CAPPA UFSM 0510).png
payload.artist_html: R. T. Müller, L. Roberto-da-Silva, O. L. Porcela Aurélio & L. Kerber
payload.credit_html: "The smallest tetrapod from the Middle Triassic of South America: a new procolophonoid parareptile from the Ladinian of Southern Brazil"
payload.description_html: Skull and mandible of Sauropia macrorhinus from the Pinheiros-Chiniquá Sequence (Ladinian) of the Santa Maria Supersequence, southern Brazil. Holotype (CAPPA/UFSM 0510) in right lateral (a), dorsal (b), anterior (c), and ventral (d) views. Left panels show photographs, center panels show schematic drawings, and right panels show 3D models. Abbreviations: ar, articular; cma, craniomandibular articulation; d, dentary; dmx, dorsal ramus of the maxilla; en, external naris; f, frontal; inb, internarial bar; mx, maxilla; n, nasal; otf, orbitotemporal fenestra; pmx, premaxilla; st, supratemporal.
